t: This is a terrace of five houses on Winscombe Street, Grade II listed. The architect Neave Brown designed it for himself and four other families, who formed a collective to build it. It matters because it came first: the house and maisonette designs here were the precursor for his later Dunboyne Road Estate and Alexandra Road Estate, both also in Camden. Brown specialised in modernist housing, and he is the only architect to have had all of his UK work listed. These houses are part of that.
